# 蓝汐摇篮

使用内置 image_gen 工具生成，原图直接复制，无后期裁切。

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: background-only illustration for the first chibi blue whale girl character in a fantasy game character collection. Portrait 1024x1536. Replace a too-realistic warm sandy beach with a tender cool-toned underwater cradle garden. A pearly shallow-water dream grotto, softly rounded nacre shell alcoves and sea-glass blue stone to the side edges, delicate luminous aquatic blossoms and translucent sea grass rooted at the sides, pale aqua water ripples over a smooth milky opal floor, faraway cyan underwater daylight, a tiny touch of blush lilac. Soft hand-painted anime storybook environment with rounded shapes and gentle brushwork, matching a very cute blue-haired chibi maid whale mascot. Center 50% deliberately open and uncluttered for a character overlay. Pale sky blue, seafoam, pearl cream and a little periwinkle; cooler and simpler than the previous golden sunrise beach. Detailed beautiful environment, not flat, not an architectural colonnade. Absolutely NO people, no characters, no animals, no bubbles, no floating props, no lettering, no watermark, no card frame or border. Background is opaque.
